errata.documented_mitigation: Disable local interrupts and freeze other CPU cache as documented; vendor SDK versions contain workaround

errata.residual_limit: No silicon fix listed; application DMA/cache ownership still needed

errata.configuration: light-sleep wake with RTC peripheral domain down
errata.documented_mitigation: Keep RTC peripheral powered; IDF4.4+ workaround
errata.driver_or_probe_implication: Power numbers must use actual workaround
errata.residual_limit: Sleep current cannot be inferred from ideal marketing mode

errata.configuration: Damaging condition: BIAS_SLEEP=0 AND PD_CUR=1; may be triggered with ULP and/or touch during Light-sleep or Deep-sleep
errata.documented_mitigation: Avoid/disable that conjunction in sleep software. Espressif reports this configuration disabled in ESP-IDF v4.4.2+ and v5.0+; verify the selected implementation.
errata.driver_or_probe_implication: Pinned IDF v6.1 rtc_sleep.c selected branches/assertions and rtc.h defaults correspond to avoidance (see s3-idf-sleep/s3-idf-rtc-header). Exact chosen callers, assertion configuration and any Rust/custom path remain unqualified. Never exercise the damaging condition as a physical test.
errata.residual_limit: Affected v0.0/v0.1/v0.2; permanent chip damage possible under the forbidden condition; no silicon fix scheduled.

errata.configuration: USB-OTG download eFuse preprogrammed
errata.documented_mitigation: Use documented alternative programming path; identify lot/eFuse
errata.driver_or_probe_implication: Do not infer USB ROM recovery from revision number alone
errata.residual_limit: Preprogrammed fuse not reversible; USB Serial/JTAG is separate

errata.configuration: ADC2 digital-controller/DMA use
errata.documented_mitigation: Use RTC controller for ADC2

errata.residual_limit: No display throughput claim from untested mode

errata.configuration: RMT configured idle level
errata.documented_mitigation: Enable IDLE_OUT_EN

errata.residual_limit: Not relevant to a GPIO-only implementation

errata.configuration: First two TOUCH_SCAN_DONE_INT interrupts have undefined raw data
